title: Build a one-page demo site
request: Create a small static site with a heading, a paragraph, and a build step that writes dist/index.html.

steps.content:
import json from pathlib import Path root = Path(__file__).parent content = json.loads((root / 'content.json').read_text()) html = f''' {content['title']}

{content['title']}

{content['body']}

''' (root / 'dist').mkdir(exist_ok=True) (root / 'dist' / 'index.html').write_text(html) print('built', root / 'dist' / 'index.html')

acceptance.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('site/dist/index.html'); assert p.is_file(), 'missing'; print(p.read_text())"
